name: Skeptical Baby
look: A close-up photo of a baby with wispy light hair, a furrowed brow and narrowed eyes, glancing sideways with pursed lips in an expression of deep suspicion. The baby wears a cream top under a brown vest, in front of a bright window.
use: Questions something that seems too good to be true or doesn't add up. The top sets up a dubious claim, and the bottom asks the skeptical question the baby seems to be thinking.
examples: You say this meeting will only take five minutes
Who are you trying to fool?
Then why do you need my card number?
